title: Api events
description: The body of GET /api/events/suspect (alias GET /api/events): one page of suspect events, newest first. The items are the suspect-event messages the detection stage publishes on the broker, so the feed a technician scrolls and the live frames carry the same document. `next_cursor` is the opaque token of the next page and is null on the last one.

items.description: The suspect events of this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token of the next page, null on the last one.
